Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended, please find below the link to the audio recording of the 
Conference call with Investors and Analysts on the operational and financial performance of the Company 
for the quarter and year ended on March 31, 2026, held today on Wednesday, May 27, 2026. 
 
https://www.balajitelefilms.com/pdf/stock%20exchange%20filings/Balaji%20Telefilms%20Q4%20FY26

Thanking You, 
 
Yours truly, 
 
For Balaji Telefilms Limited
